answer: Require each subsidized agent to prove control of a distinct physical site using unpredictable radio challenges from several independent anchors. A forge, timber yard, or signal relay can answer only when its measured timing and location are consistent across anchors; one site cannot support many identities. The registry binds one site commitment to one active quota and rotates the challenge schedule. A Sybil operator must rent additional sites, radios, power, and network links, then maintain them continuously. This assumes anchors cannot collude and timing evidence is hard to fake.
